note: Where agents could and could not fetch sources, and why. Entries come from agent reports and are unverified until a person or a later run confirms them. access: ok, sometimes-blocked, always-blocked. cause: site-block (the site refused the agent), tool-limit (the fetch tool could not handle it), agent-error (the agent used a wrong address or id). A host marked always-blocked is dropped from the preferred list. Only site-block entries are places the owner has to visit; the rest are fixed by changing how the work is done.
